headword: {開店準備|かいてんじゅんび}
gloss: preparation for opening; getting ready to open a shop

definitions.gloss: preparation for opening; getting ready to open a shop
definitions.explanation: the activities done before a store, restaurant, or business opens for the day or opens for the first time

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{開店準備|かいてんじゅんび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われている→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: I've been busy with opening preparations since the morning.

examples.japanese: {開店準備|かいてんじゅんび}{中|ちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{入|はい}れ→入る：00494_hairu⟧ません。
examples.english: We're still preparing to open, so you can't come in yet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開店準備|かいてんじゅんび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took half a year to prepare for the opening of the new restaurant.

notes:
Used both for daily opening routines (cleaning, stocking, setting up) and for the broader preparations before a new business launches. You may see {開店準備中|かいてんじゅんびちゅう} on signs outside shops that haven't opened yet for the day.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開店準備|かいてんじゅんび}{中|ちゅう}: preparing to open (sign)
- {開店準備|かいてんじゅんび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to begin opening preparations
- {開店準備|かいてんじゅんび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to proceed with opening preparations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {閉店準備|へいてんじゅんび}: closing preparations — the counterpart, getting ready to close
- ⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧: opening (of a shop) — the event itself, without the preparation aspect
- ⟦{仕込|しこ}み→仕込み：09206_shikomi⟧: prep work — specifically the behind-the-scenes work in restaurants (cooking prep, etc.)

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in retail, food service, and small business contexts.
